notes.title: The Long-Awaited Criminal Network Core Update 9.0
notes.content: [p][b]Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG [i]Criminal Network Core Update[/i][/b][/p][p][i]What’s good, Trappers?[/i] The streets are calling, and [b]Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG[/b] has answered with its most ambitious update yet: the [b]Criminal Network Core Update[/b]. This massive overhaul redefines the game’s foundation, introducing brand-new systems, revamped mechanics, and endless opportunities to rise—or fall—in the underground economy.[/p][p]This isn’t just an update. It’s the evolution of Trapper.[/p][h3]What’s New in the Criminal Network Core Update:[/h3][p][b]🗨️ Dynamic Dialog System[/b][/p][p]Conversations now pack more heat. The new dialog system categorizes conversational styles, turning every interaction into a strategic battle of big bank takes little bank.[/p][p][b]🔁 New Game Plus[/b][/p][p]Start fresh, your way. Whether stacking attributes, skills, possessions, or connections, New Game Plus gives you the tools to mold the ultimate Trapper from the jump.[/p][p][b]💸 Quick Deals[/b][/p][p]Fast money, high stakes. Smaller transactions with premium clients bring bigger yields—if you play them right. Some customers are gullible, others aren’t—charge wisely, or losing out.[/p][p][b]🕵️ Criminal Network System[/b][/p][p]Track enemies. Deploy your crew. Handle business yourself. Or call on allies for drug deals—if your reputation holds up. Every move builds or burns bridges, as contacts react to your actions and personality.[/p][p][b]🎴 All-New Card System[/b][/p][p]Gain powerful bonuses and advantages across every corner of the game. Every card is a new edge in the grind.[/p][p][b]📈 Revamped Level-Up System[/b][/p][p]No more one-dimensional grinding. Every action—from hustling to building connections—now earns you XP, making progression more dynamic than ever.[/p][h3]The Future Starts Here[/h3][p]This update is just the [b]first installment in the Criminal Network Update series[/b], but it’s the most crucial. With the back-end fully rebuilt, Trapper is now primed for rich storylines and future expansions that will push the limits of underground RPG gameplay.[/p][p][b]The streets are evolving. Are you ready to rise with them?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]I want to give a special shout-out to my son Zi Fry! While I was working on this update, you endured 3 major surgeries. Through it all, you stayed positive and encouraged me to keep working! Your strength inspires me and motivates me to go harder so we can have a better life! You are everything to me! Without you, there is no Trapper! Love you infinity![/b][/p]

Track enemies. Deploy your crew. Handle business yourself. Or call on allies for drug deals—if your reputation holds up. Every move builds or burns bridges, as contacts react to your actions and personality.

No more one-dimensional grinding. Every action—from hustling to building connections—now earns you XP, making progression more dynamic than ever.

notes.title: Like A... Update 8.7
notes.content:
What's good Trappers! The Like A... Update adds an all-new fighting system to the world of Trapper. Stamina is key so make sure to increase your fitness levels early on. This may be the difference between adding more cash in your inventory or laying in your own mess penniless. 9 new fightable characters and 3 base scenarios round out the system. You can pick a fight in the middle of a BBall game, knockout dope fiends or strongarm pedestrians in the trap. Also, the research and ability to craft Dummy Rocks has been added to the game once more. Be careful though! Crafting Dummy batches will cause Dre to take a major hit to his REP and customers per day in the trap is now dynamic. Meaning selling low quality drugs like low grade coke and dummy rocks, will lower the amount of customer you can serve per day. Selling higher quality drugs will slowly increase the number of customers you can serve per day. For more details on the update check the list below.

-All New music soundtrack created with suno and perfected by me
-New fist fighting system that allows you to attack and dodge enemy attacks
-Dummy Rock research and crafting
-Rebalanced the BBall system adding a greater focus on stamina
-Fixed a late game bug that stop crackhouse, stash house and sweatshop robberies
-Fixed a bug that caused a soft lock when exiting battle mode after home invasion fight
-The number of customers you can serve per day is now dynamic base on your decisions
-Only up to 25 units of any drug can be served per customer
-Fixed issues with the strip club causing the inability to receive new dancers
-Fixed bug that make it to where you couldn't buy the security door in the strip club
-Fixed an issue with the calendar that caused the month of December to get skipped
-BBall skill degradation takes twice as long to kick in now

notes.title: Hoop Dreams Update 8.6
notes.content:
Welcome back Trappers! With the Hoop Dreams Update 8.6 the BBall mini game has been revamped, breathing new life into the park. The system has been rebalanced, lowering the difficulty just a bit. No longer will you have to rely only on text to know what's going on. Updated visuals and a new jumpshot mini game has been added to the mix. Paired with the new BBall System is the new practice system. It allows you to keep your skills from diminishing and improve your stats. Also, a lot of bugs and issues have been addressed with this update. For the key details look below:

-New BBall System with 6 new opponents
-New Practice mode that helps to improve stats and prevents skill degradation
-Optimized the Battle Mode
-Fixed a bug that caused your Right Hand man to go to jail
-Fixed a bug that caused searching for B&E'S AND Robbery attempts to come back with no information. The screen would just say text
-Fixed a bug that caused police to come after you every time you go to the mall
-More fixes just can't think of them all

notes.title: Operation BUG KILLER Update
notes.content:
What's good Trappers! With this simple update we want to show that we hear you and want you to have the best experience possible here in Cloverland. The game has been rebalanced, and a ton of bugs have been addressed.  Also, there are 5 new plugs (6 in total) that are now available in game. They can be unlocked by chilling in the park. The first piece of research is now available allowing you to learn how to grow weed in your closet. This is a game changer in the early game. Unfortunately, Achievements are no longer working on this build of the game due to issues with the game engine but I'm confident this will be resolved in the future. For more details about the update check the list below.

-Buying clothing in the mall now gives you plus 5 drip
-Police are less likely to have to deal with when pickpocketing in the mall
-Can now run from enemies using the run mini game
-fixed issue with crew member level goonz not being able to unlock at the park
-Now wearing a bullet proof vest provides protection in run mini game, increasing your ability to survive being shoot in the back.
-Fixed a bug that cause businesses to not give the option to put sweatshops or stash houses inside of them
-New xp system that allows you to skill up at weed growing, increasing yield as you increase in skill
-Add an icon to let you know if you have entered a B&E without a ski mask
-corrected police artwork in battle mode
-Fixed issue with the escape card in battle mode that caused the game to freeze
-Fixed an issue that happened after a B&E invasion fight, causing you to get stuck in the post battle menu of the next fight
-Dre can lose his mind, leading to game over if his stress is over 1,000, if Dre is older than 40 stress can kill him if it's over 800
-Fixed an issue that cause your Right Hand Man to never return from a delivery
-Rebalance chill at the park odds
-fixed bug that causes video to loop when you go to a B&E or the Red Light District
-More small fixes and tweaks to menu navigation

notes.title: UI Update 8.4
notes.content:
Welcome back, Trappers! 🎮 The latest update to Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG injects a fresh dose of excitement into your criminal empire. Here’s what’s new:

Graphical Enhancements: Immerse yourself in the gritty underworld with enhanced visuals. Now, as you grind in the trap, your loyal enforcer stands by your side, ready to back you up.

Evolved Distributors: Say goodbye to the old cartoon-style distributors. They’ve transformed into realistic depictions, adding depth to the game world. 

New Banner Graphics: Explore the Park, Red Light District, and Office with all-new banner artwork in a captivating graphic novel style.

Club Lux Facelift: The notorious Club Lux has undergone a makeover. Its sleek new look matches the high-stakes atmosphere. 

Quality of Life UI Upgrade: Tired of multiple clicks to get to the office or to an illicit business. Well, we’ve fine-tuned the UI for smoother navigation. More locations can be found in the decisions menu, making it much easier to get to your crackhouse!

Visual Flare: Dive into the action with video shorts sprinkled throughout the game. These snippets add an extra layer of immersion, making every deal and confrontation pulse with intensity.

In-Game Tutorials: Learn the ropes like a pro! Our revamped tutorial system features in-game videos that break down the intricate systems. Master the art of the hustle.

Achievement Unlocked: Stack cash, kick ass, and earn your stripes. We’ve added 22 brand-new achievements to challenge even the savviest kingpin.
Get ready to rule the streets, Trapper! 💰💥

notes.title: Catch Me If You Can Update 8.3
notes.content:
Welcome back to the gritty streets of Cloverland, Trappers! In the adrenaline-fueled Catch Me If You Can Update 8.3, we’ve turbocharged the run system, giving you more than just the ability to sprint away from the boys in blue. Now, you can also outpace your rivals, dodging bullets and weaving through the neon-lit alleys like a pro. But remember, it’s not just about speed—it’s about survival. Keep your head on a swivel, because danger lurks around every corner.

🏃‍♂️ Run System Overhaul:

Responsive Controls: The new run system isn’t just about flashy sneakers; it’s about control. Feel the pavement beneath your feet as you sprint, slide, and duck. The visuals? Impeccable. The adrenaline? Off the charts.
Police Pursuit: Evading the cops was just the warm-up. Now, your opps are on your tail too. Your fitness level determines if you have the ability to set off for the races. Will you escape unscathed, or will you feel the sting of a bullet?

🏠 Property Portfolio Revolution:

Cloverland Real Estate Boom: The properties menu got a facelift, and it’s hotter than a stolen Lambo. We’ve got 25 new properties scattered across the city. Move your illicit businesses strategically—when the heat rises, relocate. 🏢
Newness Stat: Each property wears its age like a badge. The lower the newness stat, the juicier the target. Rivals and upstarts will be eyeing your turf. Keep 'em guessing by diversifying your holdings. 🕶️

🎵 Suno’s Soundtrack:

Handpicked Heat: Suno AI generation dropped the beats. I curated a playlist that screams “Trapper vibes.” Picture neon-lit streets, old schools, and late-night deals. 🔥
Essence and Mood: These instrumentals capture the soul of Cloverland. Whether you’re plotting a heist or cruising in your ride, let the music guide you.
In Cloverland, survival isn’t just a game—it’s life or death. 💀🔫🔥

notes.title: Executive Decision Update 8.2
notes.content:
Welcome Back Trappers! Now introducing Trapper’s Executive Decision Update 8.2!

🔥 Be the Boss: Step into your role as the head honcho with our brand-new Courier Right Hand Man system. No more micromanaging – delegate tasks and focus on the big picture!

Cash Collection: Your Right Hand Man can now pick up cash from all your businesses. No more running around – let him handle the green while you kick back in your office.
Crack Delivery Service: Need crack delivered to your crack house? Your Right Hand Man’s got it covered. Efficient, discreet, and hassle-free.
Weed and Coke Logistics: Weed and coke deliveries? Yep, he does that too. Your Right Hand Man is the ultimate multitasker.
🏪 Corner Store Management:

Three Choices: Now you have three individuals to manage your corner store. Each brings a unique flavor – choose wisely!
More Freedom, Less Profit: Delegate the corner store, but remember: less hands-on means less profit. It’s an executive decision.
👥 Human Resources System:

Goonz Defense: Deploy up to 10 lackie level Goonz at each location to protect your turf. They act as a deterrent, but when push comes to shove, they’ll fight to defend your illicit businesses.
Simulated Showdowns: If an illicit business lacks a leader, a simulated fight ensues. With 10 Goonz on your side, victory is more likely.
Raid and Robbery Expansion: Watch out! Random thugs and rival gangs can now attack your crackhouse, stash house, and sweatshop. Bolster your defense with this new system.
🚨 Stay Sharp, Your empire, your rules. Check out the full update details below!

Remember, every move you make is an Executive Decision. 🎩💼

Check out the full update details 📈

-New Courier system that makes your Right Hand Man much more valuable by letting him move drugs to different locations for you and collect cash
-New Human resource system that allows you to put lackie level goonz in different locations to add to the defense level. You can find this in office in asset review
-Added new art for safes
-Added new artwork in barbershop and laundrymat
-Added text in office that gives you an overview of how much drugs you have at all locations
-Fixed a bug that cause gameover screen to not display as intended, if Dre was shoot in the back while running from police
-Fixed a bug in the crew level up system that cause the level up meter to not work as intended
-Fixed a bug that caused homeowners to switch mid battle in the battle system
-Fixed a bug in the B&E system that wouldn't let you search the location more than once if you didn't scout
-Added banners to buttons in different locations; Park, Red Light District and office, that indictate that they advance the day and potentially provide opportunities
-Reworked the backend code of all businesses to ensue they all work as intended
-Defensive upgrades like; Security systems, security doors and bullet proof glass are now fully functioning and bolster the defense of the location
-Lackie level Goonz are now a bit harder to come by and can die in random events/simulated battles

notes.title: No Rest For the Wicked Update 8.1
notes.content:
Welcome Back Trappers! This update was really meant to patch issues in the previous update and add some quality of life measures to help players better understand the systems in the game. Problem is it spun way out of control and turned into a full update. With the No Rest for the Wicked Update the B&E, Pickpocketing and Sweatshop systems have all been revamped with all new artwork and features. A Coke Mix level up system has been added and many bugs from pervious updates have been fix. WARNING THIS GAME IS SUBJECT TO MASSIVE CHANGES THAT CAN AND WILL EFFECT YOUR PLAYTHROUGHS CURRENTLY AND IN THE FUTURE! The games current state is NOT complete! Still early access so please don't be upset when things happen! I work extremely hard on this project and all I ask for is understanding and respect! See the notes below for all of the changes in this update.

-New B&E System that allows you to choose if you want to scout the house to gain more info and get more out of the attempt or throw caution into the wind and go in guns blazing
-New sweatshop system that allows you to scale up your operation for the mid to late game. This system allows you to manage every aspect of how the sweatshop is run.
-2 new fightable characters have been added to the battle system (Homeowners can attempt to protect their homes from you during a B&E)
-New Pickpocket System in the Mall which adds new artwork to the game
-New artwork added to the search mechanics of the game; allowing you to get a picture of the neighborhoods and events going on.
-New Coke Mix level up System. No longer is it too easy to stretch coke. You must level up your skills to yield higher quality coke. Strategist starts off as a level four.
-Fixed a bug that caused search map to freeze
-Fixed a bug that caused the battle system to freeze in the bonus round
-decreased price of Fent
-Fixed a bug that caused crew level up stars to not display properly
-Added a text to the trap that lets you know how many customers you can serve before the day changes
-Added a text to mall that lets you know how many pickpockets you can do before the day changes.
-Fixed a bug that made it possible for your home to be robbed while you are in it
-Improved the robbery cooldown
-Revamp the ability to run from battles. Now its based on your fitness and your Archetype.
-Fixed a bug that cause your SUV to disappear if you buy a van
-The bonus round in battlemode has a difficulty text that will let you know how difficult it will be to win the bonus round
-Battlemode bonus round trigger has been rebalanced to be a bit easier
-xp text has been added to distributors
-Fixed a bug that caused search map to freeze if you search for victims as the Gunner.
-Now following a victim as the Gunner can lead to a home invasion
-New map icons
-Robbery cooldown code has been expanded across the game leading to less fights

notes.title: Get On My Level Update 8.0
notes.content:
Welcome back Trappers! This is a major update, so it is very likely previous saves won't work properly. Sorry for the inconvenience but it's all in the name of progress. This update includes a major graphical update to about 60 percent of the game including a whole new fleet of vehicles that can be purchased at the used car lot. The Battlemode has also received a huge facelift both cosmetically and gameplay wise. Now battles will be swift and deadly! You only have three rounds to take out your foes before everyone must flee. Well unless you opt to try your hand at one final turn but that can backfire giving your enemies a chance to take you out instead. The rounds are now timed. The first round is 60 seconds, while the second is 45 and the third is 30.
   Now in Battlemode, when you play the Nest card or similar defensive cards on offense. You will have the opportunity to reroll or remove enemy cards on defense. Use these opportunities to remove heavy hitting enemy cards like All-Hit or Onslaught. You will also be able to upgrade your defensive cards with the new Crew level up system. This system will allow you to gain xp in battle to progress Dre and his goonz. Each level unlocked gives characters new skills or boosted stats that can be used in battle. Also a ton of bug fixes. I will be dropping a patch in the next 2 weeks so if you find any bugs please drop a comment in the forums.

-Graphical Update across the entire game
-New animations across the entire game
-New Level Up System
-Defensive cards in Battlemode have new abilities
-11 new vehicles

notes.title: Trapper Weed Grow Crafting Update 7.2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3duAP977uIk;full][/previewyoutube]Welcome back Trappers! With this update you can now grow your own weed. Start off in the closet of your home and scale up to the warehouse. In order to set up the closet build a relationship with K Kush from weed delivery opportunities. You can grow up to 4 plants at a time. Get started by going to the revamped mall. The Plant Rite store is where you can find pots, grow tents and other items you can buy to start and enhance your ability to grow weed. Water and watch your weed plants grow from the seedling stage to the flowering stage. It's important to remain vigilant. The growth process isn't just a walk in the park. Plants can spawn as male or female. Female plants yield those beautiful flowers that hippies love to set on fire, while male plants wish to pollinate the females. This causes the females to have low yields, that are full of seeds. Next build a grow operation within your warehouse. At this level the process isn't as hands on. You take a managerial role by hiring and scaling up the operation. I hope you have been enjoying the pace and quality of the latest updates. Coming up next is the largest update to date... The Criminal Network Update! Stay tuned because things are about to get real. Check below for all the features contained in the latest updates.

-New weed growing system that allows you to grow up to 4 weed plants

notes.title: Trapper Dope Boy Magic Crafting Update 7.1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fKetR8hIEv0;full][/previewyoutube]Welcome back Trappers! In the Dope Boy Magic Crafting Update 2 new systems have been added. The Coke Cutting mini-game and the Crack Cooking mini-game. First off, the Coke Cutting mini-game allows you to take higher grades of coke and mix them with diluting agents (baby laxatives, meat tenderizer and laundry detergent) and enhancing agents (aspirin, lidocine, borox and fentanol; the games version of a powerful opioid). The point of the game is to keep the potency above certain thresholds, while stretching the product to increase profits. Each threshold has different levels of risk to lower the quality of the coke. The Crack Cooking mini-game utilizes a simple game similar to a color based game of sudoku(which represents how well you whip the work). The more baking soda you use, the more likely you are to burn the mixture. With greater risk there are even greater rewards because if you are successful, you can more than double the volume of crack you end up with! This update features many more upgrades and bug fixes. Check the notes below for more details!
-2 new mini-games that give the player greater control of product
-Revamped sweatshop with enhanced UI and greater earning potential
-Revamped Pharmacy Opportunities with more drugs for purchase, lower prices and greater earning potential
-Revamped Corner Store with new items and upgraded UI
-New Over Flow system that holds drugs that don't fit in your inventory; at the risk of being stolen
-More Gang interactions
-Fixed bug in B&E reaction that caused error in the number of drugs stole in home invasion
-Fixed bug that caused an inability for coke to be delivered
-added ability to sell low, mid and high quality coke in the trap by clicking the coke icon

P.S. New youtube tutorial drops tomorrow to teach you guys how to use all of these new features!

notes.title: Battle Mode Complete Update 6.3
notes.content:
Welcome Back Trappers! In update 6.3 I focused my efforts on completing the battle system. 18 fightable characters have been added to the battle system. Police, weed delivery contacts, and coke delivery contacts. Weed and coke connects have special moves they can pull off during combat. The enemy AI has been completely rebuilt. If Dre is injured during battle he will end up in the hospital where you have the choice to rest, heal, and stack up hospital bills; or leave the hospital early and risk ending up in battle with low hp.

The equipped weapon bug is fixed, no more having to re-equip your weapon every time you sell a weapon. More opportunities to gradually reduce stress have been added. Stash house graphic has been fixed. Sweatshop leader button has been fixed and more.

notes.title: Battle Mode UI Update 6.2
notes.content: What's up Trappers! It has been a long and bumpy ride but finally the newest update to Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG has Arrived! With this update I have corrected a lot of the issues from the previous builds battle system and did some optimization as well. Now it should not be as hard to reach the target number and I have completely removed any possibility for the dreaded black screen of death to pop up during battle! I completely revamped the girlfriends and distributors system of the game giving them a new lease on life. I added 7 new potential girlfriends and distributors have a leveling system the allows them to sell 2 different types of drugs once they reach level 4. I have added several new businesses to the game that allow you to micromanage them to your hearts content. You have the option to put a stash house or even a sweatshop in the backroom of most of them to really increase profits! New houses have been added as well. They can be manipulated in a similar manner as the businesses, but you also have the option to turn them into a crack house as well. Having option is a great thing with the new raid and robbery system you will need to move your illicit activities as local heat raises to stay clear of the police and stickup kids! The Gunner and Ninja archetypes have received new abilities that alter the game loop in an enormous way! Now as the Gunner you can seek out victims to rob for some quick cash and jewelry that you can sell at the local pawnshop. The Ninja also has a similar ability, except he can canvas neighborhood on his own for B&E opportunities, instead of just waiting for them to fall in his lap. The UI has gotten an upgrade allowing you to navigate through the game with ease and the buttons are now located in similar places on each screen if they are available. There is so much packed into this update I struggle to recall everything in it. Warning this update has massive changes to the foundation of the game and it is very like you may need to restart your playthrough. I hate to cause you guys such inconvenience but it's a small price to pay for the continued growth of Trapper!

notes.title: Battle Mode Update 6.1
notes.content: [previewyoutube=uhgsgLU3JWg;full][/previewyoutube]I know it has been a long time in the works but today the new battle system has been added to Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG. The NEW battle system allows you to take up to 4 of your crew members into nail-bitting combat scenarios that put you up against 3 to 6 enemies. You can have your crew members and lackies fight to the death for you while staying out of danger or risk it all and join in on the fun. If you have established a gang you can have your lead enforcer step into battle to crush your foes. Once you have a crackhouse up and running, during robbery attempts you gain control of the crackhouse leader to fight to protect the stash and money. This new system gives you access to all 9 of your potential crew members in ways not yet seen in the Trapper Universe. This update will serve as the foundational piece that spurs tons of decision-making possibilities in future iterations of the game. With this massive update complete future updates are likely to begin to arrive in much more of a timely manner so keep your eyes peeled for update 6.2 where more characters will be added into the equation. Check out the Lathon gaming Youtube channel for video tutorials. If you happen to find any bugs in the new build of the game don't hesitate to post your issues in the new bug forum on the community tab. Road map update will be presented in the next two weeks,,, Stay Tuned Trappers!!!
